notes: Keybinds are now grouped by their real mod (Xaero's Minimap, Xaero's World Map, Voice Chat, Jade, Physics Mod, Essential, Iris...) with no raw key ids anywhere. False-update fix: Physics Mod Pro can no longer be mistaken for the free Physics Mod (manual installs only link by exact SHA-1; wrongly-linked items are healed automatically and unlinked installs never get an update badge). Downloads show the real project cover art for version-specific installs and modpacks. Credits > About has Open Folder / Copy Path on the data directory. Performance settings: recommended RAM and sessions-learned are separated so the numbers can't be confused, explanations are cleaner, and tier reasons got a 'Why this profile' header. Title-bar music player: bigger volume hitbox and more comfortable spacing. Launch state can never stick on 'Launching...': it resets on every fresh start and a 3-minute watchdog returns to idle if the game never appears.
